name.description: The name of the resource (e.g., 'users' for UsersDataService). Required unless --document is given; defaults to the dasherized bound node id.

path.description: The destination path for the data service (e.g., 'features/users/services' or 'core/services')

apiService.description: The name of the generated OpenAPI service to wrap (e.g., 'UsersApiService'). If not provided, will be inferred from the resource name. Not allowed with --document.

apiPath.description: The import path to the generated API service. Defaults to '../api/services'. Not allowed with --document.

flat.description: When true, creates the service file directly in the specified path instead of creating a subdirectory

skipTests.description: When true, does not create a spec file

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). The bound node's [data]="<apiPath>#<ApiService>" names the generated services module (application path, e.g. src/app/api/services) and service class.

nodeId.description: Optional id of the bound node. When omitted, targets the first element with a [data] binding. Requires --document.
